dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "sentry"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for stability. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies, and sets default command to run Sentry. Assumes main module is 'sentry' - adjust CMD if entrypoint differs.
